summary:

summary:

title: India & UK seek to double trade by 2030 under CETA
summary:

Both sides also called for clear guidance on tariffs, origin rules and customs procedures.

summary:
India's Minister of Commerce Piyush Goyal said India must combine access to advanced global technologies with job creation and business growth.

title: South Indian cotton yarn firms as higher fibre prices lift sentiment
summary:

title: Britain’s unworn clothes waste billions of litres of water: Oxfam
summary:
An Oxfam UK report has claimed that social media is fuelling fast fashion, placing digital influence in focus for the apparel and fashion sector.
